title: BellowsKV: One Latent for Many Layers, Expanded on Demand
summary: BellowsKV replaces the per-layer KV cache with a single full-dimension latent shared across blocks of adjacent layers, reconstructed per layer through layer-specific projections, and compresses that latent via quantization (BellowsKV-Quant) or shared eviction decisions (BellowsKV-Evict) rather than dimension reduction. It is training-free, so the cost is integrating custom cache-management code into the serving stack, small per-layer projection overhead at decode time, and possible accuracy loss at the highest compression ratios. It can fail on models or workloads where adjacent hidden states are less similar than reported, on long-context tasks sensitive to eviction errors, or where the inference framework lacks hooks for cross-layer cache sharing.
rationale: The method is training-free and directly reduces KV-cache memory on a single GPU, but the gains must be validated on the reader's specific model and workload before production adoption.
technique: Cross-layer shared KV latent with on-demand expansion

claims.statement: BellowsKV replaces the per-layer KV cache with a single full-dimension latent shared across blocks of adjacent layers, reconstructed per layer through layer-specific projections, and compresses that latent via quantization (BellowsKV-Quant) or shared eviction decisions (BellowsKV-Evict) rather than dimension reduction. It is training-free, so the cost is integrating custom cache-management code into the serving stack, small per-layer projection overhead at decode time, and possible accuracy loss at the highest compression ratios. It can fail on models or workloads where adjacent hidden states are less similar than reported, on long-context tasks sensitive to eviction errors, or where the inference framework lacks hooks for cross-layer cache sharing.

Retains 97-98% of full-cache accuracy at 13-14x KV-cache compression (about 99% at 3.6x), where the strongest prior cross-layer method retains at most 84% at 16x, on Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B.
